scoring_justification: Scored artifacts are final derived values (relative energies and chemical-potential crossings). The checker compares agent-reported numbers against paper-reported golds with tolerance. Recomputing from raw DFT total energies would require storing large intermediate files not in contract; T0 is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for each termination relative energy and chemical-potential crossing.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from paper's Table 3, 4, 5, 6 and crossings text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted exactly as reported in the paper (units meV/Å² and eV).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual published numbers; no fabrication.

outputs.description: 0 K relative surface energies for the oxygen series terminations. Values are compared to hidden gold with tolerance; lower absolute deviations earn full credit.
0 K relative surface energies for the hydrogen series terminations. Scored similarly to oxygen series.
0 K relative surface energies for the water series terminations. Scored similarly to oxygen series.
Chemical-potential crossing points between terminations I↔II and II↔IV. Compared to hidden gold with tolerance.

output_contract.notes: All relative energies are with respect to the bare Cr-terminated surface (I) and use the slab double-cell construction. The chemical-potential crossings are derived from the oxygen relative energies at 0 K. The agent must perform the full DFT calculations; no pre-computed energies are provided.
